rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Corporate income tax [national]
rows.value: 17% of chargeable income; partial exemption (up to $102,500 exempt) or start-up exemption (up to $125,000, first 3 YAs); YA 2026 rebate 50% up to $40,000; 15% minimum tax (MTT and DTT) for groups with revenue of at least €750 million. Paid by companies, local and foreign, including branches. Income Tax Act 1947, sections 43 and 92M; Multinational Enterprise (Minimum Tax) Act 2024.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: IRAS: Corporate Income Tax Rate, Rebates & Tax Exemption Schemes (last updated 7 August 2026); Basic Guide to Corporate Income Tax for Companies (last updated 20 October 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: none on dividends (one-tier system, no dividend withholding); branches pay corporate income tax at 17%. Paid by no one on dividends; branches pay corporate income tax. Income Tax Act 1947 (one-tier corporate tax system).
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: IRAS: Payments that are Not Subject to Withholding Tax (last updated 14 August 2026); Dividends (last updated 27 February 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Self-employed contributions: MediSave and platform workers' CPF [national]
rows.value: MediSave 4% to 10.5% of net trade income above $6,000 (maximum $10,080); platform workers 5.5% to 15.5% plus operator 7% in 2026. Paid by self-employed citizens and PRs; platform workers and platform operators. Central Provident Fund Act 1953; Platform Workers Act 2024.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: CPF Board: CPF Contribution Rate Tables for platform workers, 2025 to 2029 (accurate as of March 2026); How much CPF contributions to pay platform workers (last updated 25 May 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Contractor rules: employee or self-employed test and non-resident withholding [national]
rows.value: withholding only on payments to non-residents; MOM test (control, ownership of tools, economic factors); non-resident professionals 15% of gross fees or 24% of net income. Paid by the payer, for payments to non-residents (section 45). Income Tax Act 1947, section 45; Employment Act 1968.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Simplified filing for small businesses (2-line statement, Form C-S Lite) [national]
rows.value: no presumptive tax; 2-line statement for revenue up to $200,000; Form C-S up to $5,000,000 and Form C-S (Lite) up to $200,000 of revenue. Paid by no one: simpler returns for small sole proprietors and companies. Income Tax Act 1947.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: IRAS: Overview of Form C-S/ Form C-S (Lite)/ Form C (last updated 11 August 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: higher of 15% or the resident rates, no personal reliefs; exempt for employment of 60 days or less in a year; directors 24%. Paid by non-resident employees (assessed; tax clearance on leaving). Income Tax Act 1947.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Property tax [national]
rows.value: annual value × rate: owner-occupied homes 0% to 32%, other homes 12% to 36%, other property 10%. Paid by property owners. Property Tax Act 1960.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, CPF, SDL and the foreign worker levy are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.label: Property transfer: buyer's, additional buyer's and seller's stamp duty [national]
rows.value: BSD 1% to 6% (residential); ABSD 5% to 65% by buyer profile (foreigners 60%); SSD 4% to 16% on homes sold within 4 years. Paid by buyers (BSD, ABSD) and sellers (SSD). Stamp Duties Act 1929.
